title: Sign in to DeepChat
description: Use your organization LDAP account to complete unified authentication. The login page opens in your system browser, then DeepChat continues after the sign-in starts.

errors.missingUrl: LDAP login URL is not configured. Contact your administrator.
errors.openFailed: Unable to open the LDAP login page. Try again later or contact your administrator.

footer: The LDAP login URL is provided at package time with VITE_LDAP_LOGIN_URL.
